scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-signal SIGTERM --kill-timeout 30000 --names web,api,worker --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta --pad-prefix "npm run dev --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/web" "npm run dev --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/api" "npm run dev --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/worker"
scripts.build:api: npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/ai && npm run typecheck --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/api
scripts.build:worker: npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/ai && npm run typecheck --workspace @developer-knowledge-hub/worker
